cover.title: Sō Percussion with Helado Negro and Kate Stables (This Is the Kit)
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: Through a mix of consummate skill and quirky charm, [Sō Percussion] has helped to ignite an explosive new enthusiasm for percussion music old and new. The New York Times

sections.title: Welcome
body: Three visionary acts, one unforgettable night. New-music powerhouse Sō Percussion joins indie-folk storyteller Kate Stables (This Is the Kit) and avant-pop innovator Helado Negro for a thrilling collision of rhythm, song, and invention. Embrace the unexpected as the trio reimagines their catalogs in an evening of spontaneous, joyful, and deeply collaborative music-making you’ll remember for days to come.
